scene_breakdown.label: Hook
scene_breakdown.summary: A toaster sits on a kitchen counter at night. It shakes slightly. Tiny yelling comes from inside. The lever trembles. Warm orange light leaks from the slots.
scene_breakdown.caption:
I heard yelling
from my toaster.
scene_breakdown.audio: crowd murmur + toaster hum + tiny voice line: referee_crumb "Round one!"

scene_breakdown.label: Reveal
scene_breakdown.summary: Camera moves into the toaster slot. Inside, a clear tiny boxing ring is visible, made of toast crumbs and tiny ropes, with ring corners and posts clearly readable. A crumb crowd cheers around it.
scene_breakdown.caption: It wasn't making toast. / It was a fight.

scene_breakdown.label: Fighters
scene_breakdown.summary: Two anthropomorphic bread-slice boxers stand inside the ring, clearly readable, circling each other: one light wheat/white bread with red gloves, one dark rye bread with blue gloves, both with expressive faces (eyes, eyebrows, mouth), small arms and legs, an original tiny referee character between them.
scene_breakdown.caption: “You're burnt, rye.” / “Say that again.” / “I'll f*** you up, mate.”
scene_breakdown.audio: wheat_bread: "You're burnt, rye." / dark_rye: "Say that again." / wheat_bread: "I'll fuck you up, mate." (spoken uncensored in audio, shrill/aggressive; caption only is censored — no beep on this line) + crowd murmur under dialogue

scene_breakdown.label: Turnaround punch
scene_breakdown.summary: Dark rye bread suddenly switches stance and throws one clear, soft, readable punch. Wheat/white bread reacts dramatically and falls backward onto soft crumbs. No blood, no gore, playful surreal boxing beat.
scene_breakdown.caption: “Wrong toaster.” / ONE PUNCH. / White bread went down.
scene_breakdown.audio: dark_rye: "Wrong toaster." (calm, cold, near-whisper) + boxing bell + soft punch thump + crowd_crumbs: "OHHH!" gasp

scene_breakdown.label: Final
scene_breakdown.summary: The toaster dings normally. The dark rye bread character pops out of the toaster wearing a tiny championship belt and boxing gloves, crumbs cheering from inside. The kitchen looks normal again.
scene_breakdown.caption: The toaster dinged. / “Breakfast is over, b****.” / Should I eat the winner?
scene_breakdown.audio: toaster ding + crowd cheer + dark_rye: "Breakfast is over, bitch." (spoken uncensored in audio, calm/dry delivery; caption only is censored, no beep) + final magical hit/sparkle
